text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Armed forces kill 46 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas in two-day operation in mainly Kurdish southeast.
- Education ministry will propose a new secularist education plan to the National Security Council at its next meeting by the end of April.
- Islamist MP stopped the opening of a home for 90 orphans as it would be mixed gender.
- Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan blocking a proposal to prosecute two MPs from his coalition partner's party who have been implicated in a security scandal.
- A military report reveals that two members of the intelligence service provided food and other supplies to the PKK throughout the winter.
- Son of late leader of the far-right National Action Party (MHP) is the only candidate for leadership of the party.
- The visiting International Monetary Fund (IMF) delegation begins its final evaluation meetings.
- Parties begin tentative preparations for early elections as a last resort to solve deadlocked political situation.
